no rules files.what: no AGENTS.md, so the agents have no written rules here

CLAUDE.md only.what: CLAUDE.md has the rules, but only Claude Code reads them
CLAUDE.md only.fix: move the rules from CLAUDE.md to a new AGENTS.md, then add the line `@AGENTS.md` to CLAUDE.md, so Claude Code still reads them

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md with no import.what: CLAUDE.md does not import AGENTS.md, so Claude Code does not read the rules
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md with no import.fix: add a line `@AGENTS.md` at the end of CLAUDE.md, or run `yokoten init`

AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md with no imp.what: .claude/CLAUDE.md does not import AGENTS.md, so Claude Code does not read the rules
AGENTS.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md with no imp.fix: add a line `@../AGENTS.md` at the end of .claude/CLAUDE.md, or run `yokoten init`

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md is a link to anothe.what: CLAUDE.md does not import AGENTS.md, so Claude Code does not read the rules
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md is a link to anothe.fix: CLAUDE.md is a link to OTHER.md: add a line `@AGENTS.md` to that file, or make CLAUDE.md a plain file
